name: image-tools
description: Local images with sharp: metadata, resize, crop, rotate, convert (jpeg/png/webp/avif), compress, text or image watermarks and thumbnails, on files in allowed directories

nodes.title: Read image metadata
nodes.description: Format, displayed width and height (after EXIF orientation), channels, colour space, alpha, density, pages and whether EXIF/ICC/XMP data is present

input.description: Image file (jpeg, png, webp, gif, tiff, avif, heif) inside IMAGE_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or IMAGE_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Resize an image
nodes.description: Resizes to target_width and/or target_height (the other side keeps the aspect ratio). `fit` decides how both sides are used: inside (default), cover (crop), contain (pad), fill (stretch), outside

input.description: Image file (jpeg, png, webp, gif, tiff, avif, heif) inside IMAGE_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or IMAGE_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

enlarge.description: Allow making the image bigger than the original

format.description: Output format (default: the input's format; heif becomes jpeg)

quality.description: Encoder quality 1-100 (jpeg, webp, avif, tiff; for png it enables palette quantisation)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Crop an image
nodes.description: Cuts out a rectangle given by left, top, crop_width and crop_height in pixels of the displayed (auto-oriented) image

input.description: Image file (jpeg, png, webp, gif, tiff, avif, heif) inside IMAGE_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or IMAGE_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

crop_width.description: Width of the box in pixels

crop_height.description: Height of the box in pixels

format.description: Output format (default: the input's format; heif becomes jpeg)

quality.description: Encoder quality 1-100 (jpeg, webp, avif, tiff; for png it enables palette quantisation)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Rotate or flip an image
nodes.description: Rotates by any angle (multiples of 90 are lossless in size; other angles fill corners with `background`) and optionally mirrors vertically (flip) or horizontally (flop)

input.description: Image file (jpeg, png, webp, gif, tiff, avif, heif) inside IMAGE_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or IMAGE_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

background.description: Corner fill colour for non-right angles (hex)

format.description: Output format (default: the input's format; heif becomes jpeg)

quality.description: Encoder quality 1-100 (jpeg, webp, avif, tiff; for png it enables palette quantisation)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Convert an image
nodes.description: Re-encodes an image as jpeg, png, webp, avif, gif or tiff

input.description: Image file (jpeg, png, webp, gif, tiff, avif, heif) inside IMAGE_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or IMAGE_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

quality.description: Encoder quality 1-100 (jpeg, webp, avif, tiff; for png it enables palette quantisation)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Compress an image
nodes.description: Re-encodes at a lower quality (default 75) without metadata, optionally capping the longest side; reports the size saved

input.description: Image file (jpeg, png, webp, gif, tiff, avif, heif) inside IMAGE_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or IMAGE_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

quality.description: Encoder quality 1-100 (jpeg, webp, avif, tiff; for png it enables palette quantisation)

max_dimension.description: Shrink so neither side is longer than this

format.description: Output format (default: the input's format; heif becomes jpeg)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Make thumbnails
nodes.description: Writes up to 10 thumbnails of one image at the given widths (aspect ratio kept, never enlarged), default webp

input.description: Image file (jpeg, png, webp, gif, tiff, avif, heif) inside IMAGE_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or IMAGE_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

format.description: Output format (default: the input's format; heif becomes jpeg)

quality.description: Encoder quality 1-100 (jpeg, webp, avif, tiff; for png it enables palette quantisation)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Add a watermark
nodes.description: Places a text line or a second image (scaled to a share of the width) on an image at one of nine positions, with margin and opacity

input.description: Image file (jpeg, png, webp, gif, tiff, avif, heif) inside IMAGE_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS (or IMAGE_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

text.description: Watermark text (at most 200 characters); pass this or `image`

image.description: Watermark image inside IMAGE_TOOLS_INPUT_DIRS; pass this or `text`

margin.description: Distance from the edges in pixels

font_size.description: Text size in pixels (default: 1/25 of the width)

image_scale.description: Watermark image width as a share of the input width

format.description: Output format (default: the input's format; heif becomes jpeg)

quality.description: Encoder quality 1-100 (jpeg, webp, avif, tiff; for png it enables palette quantisation)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
